scenarios.label: Full desk sweep
scenarios.question: Full desk sweep across every channel - what is actually tradeable right now?
scenarios.note: Exercises all seven channels in one pass. Best first thing to run.

scenarios.label: Earnings expectation gaps
scenarios.question: Walk me through the earnings expectation gaps in scope. Which print is wide enough versus consensus to actually reprice the name, and which is already discounted?
scenarios.note: Shows consensus-vs-actual, guidance stance classification and the beat-but-ugly case.

scenarios.label: CPI transmission
scenarios.question: The August CPI print came in cool on the headline but hot on core. Map the transmission chain and tell me who is most exposed cross-sectionally.
scenarios.note: The ranking is computed from measured 252-session OLS betas, not asserted.

scenarios.label: Weekend rToken window
scenarios.question: A tariff framework just landed on a Saturday afternoon. The cash market is shut for 47 hours but the rToken still trades. How should I think about pricing that gap?
scenarios.note: The core S2 scenario: 7x24 tokenized equity versus a 6.5-hour cash session.

scenarios.label: Insider and 13F flows
scenarios.question: Any insider selling clusters or 13F position changes I should know about?
scenarios.note: Aggregates are recomputed from the raw snapshot by the evidence ledger.

scenarios.label: Bear case hunt
scenarios.question: Run the contrarian screen. Where is the language softening and where do the accounting ratios diverge from the narrative?
scenarios.note: Adverse-language and ratio-anomaly flags. Demo issuers are fictional by design.
